meta.note: Every phone number, address and opening-hours value below was copied from a published source listed in the entry's "source" field. Nothing was invented. Where a phone or hours could not be verified, the field is null and the UI says so plainly. Hours are daily (same every day) unless noted. Times are Bangladesh time. Phone check 2026-11-25: a number is flagged phoneVerified=false when it contains an ascending/descending run of 5+ digits or 5+ identical digits (Care Pharmacy — Banani, +8801612345680, contains 123456). A 4-digit repeat alone does not flag a number: Islamia Habib (+8801763666686, contains 6666) is kept verified because it is published on the chain's own official site. Geocoding 2026-11-25 (OpenStreetMap Nominatim, 1 req/sec): 0 of 41 addresses returned a confident building-level match, so lat/lng are null for all — no coordinates were invented and no area-centre point is used as a pharmacy location. sourceTier is derived from the existing source field: official = the chain's own official site (Islamia, 7), hospital = a hospital's own site (Green Life, Khidmah, Square, 3), directory = all other published listings (31).
